title: The Awakening
mission: Locate the hidden flag (.hidden_flag) concealed in your home directory.
hint: Files starting with a '.' are hidden by default. Check 'man ls' to see how to list all files.

title: The Reading Room
mission: Navigate into 'archives/classified/2026' and read the secret document. Beware of spaces in filenames!
hint: Use 'cd' to change into directories. Wrap filenames with spaces in quotes or escape with a backslash: cat 'top secret document.txt'

title: Ink and Paper
mission: The server launch daemon is awaiting configuration in 'dispatch.conf'. Use 'echo' with redirection ('>' and '>>') to write the required configuration keys. Once completed, execute './verify_dispatch' to reveal your flag!
hint: Write 'MODE=ACTIVE' using '>' (overwrites), and 'TARGET=PRODUCTION' using '>>' (appends without overwriting). Check your work with 'cat dispatch.conf'.

title: Housekeeping
mission: An archive payload was misplaced as 'staging/temp_payload.dat'. Move it to 'production/app_payload.dat', and create a duplicate backup copy at 'backups/app_payload.dat'. Run './check_production' to verify!
hint: Use 'mv staging/temp_payload.dat production/app_payload.dat' to move and rename, then 'cp production/app_payload.dat backups/app_payload.dat' to duplicate. Verify with './check_production'.

title: Excavation
mission: The storage area 'sandbox/clutter' is full of junk. Locate 'sandbox/clutter/secret_key.txt' (which contains the flag), create the directory 'sandbox/secure_vault', and move the key into it. Run './verify_vault' to complete the mission!
hint: Use 'mkdir -p sandbox/secure_vault' to create the vault directory, then move 'sandbox/clutter/secret_key.txt' into it. Read the key with 'cat'.

title: Compass and Map
mission: A custom diagnostic binary 'sec-beacon' is installed on the system PATH. Locate it using 'which' or 'whereis', and execute it to extract the beacon key!
hint: Run 'which sec-beacon' to display its path, then execute it simply by typing 'sec-beacon'.

title: Disguised Identities
mission: Inspect the files inside 'suspects/'. All files have misleading extensions (.png, .mp3, .pdf, .bin, .tar). Exactly one file is an ASCII text file containing the mission flag. Use 'file' to discover it!
hint: Run 'file suspects/*' to analyze file signatures. Identify the ASCII text file and view it with 'cat'.

title: Head and Shoulders
mission: The telemetry stream 'sensor_stream.log' contains 1,000 lines of data. The mission flag is recorded precisely at line 500. Use 'head' and 'tail' to extract line 500!
hint: Pipe 'head' into 'tail': 'head -n 500 sensor_stream.log | tail -n 1' to isolate the exact line.

title: By the Numbers
mission: The folder 'transcripts/' holds multiple candidate files. The authentic classified debrief has exactly 42 lines. Use 'wc -l' to find the 42-line file and read the flag!
hint: Run 'wc -l transcripts/*' to see the line counts of all files. Find the 42-line file, then inspect it with 'cat'.

title: The Lone Survivor
mission: The file 'transaction_hashes.txt' contains 200 transaction tokens with duplicates. Exactly one token is unique without any duplicate. Use 'sort' and 'uniq -u' to filter out duplicates and isolate the flag!
hint: Sort the file before deduplication: 'sort transaction_hashes.txt | uniq -u'.

title: Cipher Shift
mission: An intercepted transmission 'intercepted.enc' was scrambled using a classic ROT13 cipher. Decipher the message using 'tr' to reveal the plaintext flag!
hint: Use 'tr' to translate character sets: tr 'A-Za-z' 'N-ZA-Mn-za-m' < intercepted.enc.

title: The Log Whisperer
mission: The 'logs/' directory contains dozens of access logs with thousands of web requests. Find the suspicious entry tagged with error code 'ERR_LEAK_9918' and extract the leaked flag!
hint: Use 'grep -rn "ERR_LEAK_9918" logs/' to recursively search all log files and display line numbers.

title: Needle in the Haystack
mission: The 'storage/' directory contains deeply nested folders and decoy files. Find the file named 'access.key' that has a file size greater than 50 bytes using 'find' to discover the flag!
hint: Run 'find storage/ -name "access.key" -size +50c' to search by name and size, then 'cat' the matching file.

title: The Vault
mission: A compressed archive 'classified_vault.tar.gz' has arrived. Decompress and unpack the archive using 'tar' to inspect 'vault_data/credentials.txt' and retrieve the flag!
hint: Run 'tar -xzf classified_vault.tar.gz' to decompress and extract the archive contents.

title: Master of the Shell
mission: Capstone Challenge! Analyze the telemetry file 'network_traffic.csv'. Extract the client IP addresses (column 2), filter by port '443', count occurrences with 'uniq -c', and find the IP with the highest traffic volume. Once identified, run './report_attacker <IP>' to earn the master flag!
hint: Build a pipeline: 'grep ",443," network_traffic.csv | cut -d"," -f2 | sort | uniq -c | sort -nr | head -n 1'. Then execute './report_attacker <IP>'.
